Make it a choice or at least an email and I’ll try again and then review the app based on what it offers.

reviews.title: Disappointing marketing app
reviews.body:
Very disappointed ... I wanted to try the app first...the free 1 week trial .... they won’t even allow you to use the app without giving them your phone number to send promotional offers.... I decided to pay the $12.99 yearly subscription fee to avoid the marketing info...they still required it....yes, there is an option to cancel promotional offers but not until you’ve accepted them and used your phone number ...very leery of my phone number being sold to telemarketers...
It seems this company is more concerned with that than anything else...not very Christian...at all... I was looking forward to this app until I realized how much info they demand before use...even after paying the subscription fee...I cancelled the subscription and deleted the app...buyer beware... ....I read other reviews of people receiving promotional texts 5 times a day and they won’t stop...
